generation: Offline catalogs generated using Google Translate from the unchanged public revision and listed generic authored interface labels. English has curated terminology; additional languages are machine-generated with limited terminology overrides. Simplified Chinese also covers the authored English controls.
privacy: Only immutable public git-show source literals and explicitly listed generic authored interface labels were submitted. No user files, credentials, database content or real library filenames were included.
runtime: All translations are bundled locally. The application does not call a translation service.
